title: Module Result
description: Result reported by an intervention module back to the platform. Describes what happened after the warning was shown.

shown.description: Whether the intervention was actually displayed to the user.

outcome.description: What the person did: dismissed the warning, clicked through to a help service, left the page entirely, continued browsing, or the warning timed out.

helpServiceId.description: If outcome is clicked_help, which service was clicked. Null otherwise.

durationMs.description: How long the intervention was visible, in milliseconds.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the result was recorded.
